convert_unet_hor32: convert a diffuser temporal UNet model with horizon 32 to diffusers UNet1DModel format
convert_unet_hor128: convert a diffuser temporal UNet model with horizon 128 to diffusers UNet1DModel format
convert_value_function: convert a diffuser value function model to diffusers UNet1DModel format and save to hub
run_model_conversion: run the script to convert hopper-medium-v2 UNet and value function models to diffusers format
remap_state_dict_keys: remap diffuser model state dict keys to match diffusers UNet1DModel expected key names
